messages:
Maria K: Quick check — in the SCIM offboard (auto-suspend) run later today, are we redacting email addresses and external_id in the audit logs? Need to confirm for privacy QA. @Aj Chen @Sowmya Rao
Aj Chen: We currently mask emails except the domain, e.g., `***@example.com`. External_id is logged in full for matching; why the concern?
Maria K: Privacy asked to avoid any PII leakage to SRE logs — external_id may contain HR IDs. Can we hash it instead of storing raw?
Sowmya Rao: Hashing sounds fine. Caveat: alerting and diffs rely on raw external_id for group mapping. Might break some rule queries.
Tom B: Agree with Sowmya. We could store a deterministic HMAC with a team key so matching still works but it's not raw PII.
Maria K: Perfect. Is there an easy regex we can apply to the audit pipeline to redact emails right now? Or a quick transform for dataflow?
Aj Chen: Put this into the log transformation step:
```
// redact emails
message = message.replace(/([\w.+-]+)@([\w.-]+)/g, '***@$2')
// hash external_id
message = message.replace(/external_id=(\w+)/g, (m,p) => `external_id=hmac(${p})`)
```
Sowmya Rao: Need to ensure hmac key comes from KMS; don't hardcode in node transform.
security-bot: Deploy scheduled: log-transform-service v2.4.1 will roll at 14:00 UTC — rollback window 20m.
Maria K: Who can add the KMS wiring and update the alerting queries to use the HMAC form? Don't want to miss the test.
Tom B: I can do KMS wiring + a small PR for transform. Will update alerting rules after deploy.
Aj Chen: I can run the offboard test and validate that the sample logs show `external_id=hmac(...)` and emails masked.
Sowmya Rao: Also note: SCIM group sync emits group.membership_count — that's safe. No PII there.
Maria K: Thanks — please tag me when the PR is up. Privacy wants a note in the offboard runbook.
Tom B: Will open PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1482 :construction:
Aj Chen: I'll validate post-merge and drop sample logs in #eng-security and in the ticket.
Maria K: Awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
security-bot: Audit entry created for runbook update request — ticket INF-3127
Maria K: Closing loop — if anything blocks the 14:00 deploy ping me. If not, I'll run the offboard test at 15:00 UTC.
